text: Figure 5.1: J1939 Transport Layer interactions The J1939Tp’s upper interface offers the PduR module access to transmitted and received N-SDUs corresponding to J1939 PGs with a maximum length of more than 8 bytes of data. J1939 PGs with a maximum length of 8 bytes or less are exchanged directly between PduR and CanIf via LSduR. ransportLayer
